IC1: Age between 1 month and 24 months of age (not beyond second birthday at baseline).
IC3: At least an average of 4 seizures/week in baseline period.
IC4: Failed response [AND] to previous trial [AND] of two anti-epileptic drugs. In the case of infantile spasms this could include a trial of corticosteroids.
IC5: Children with written informed consent from parent/guardian.
